ArchetypeProperty.Name: MinChallengeInterval
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Minimum seconds between audit challenges (actual interval is random within [min, max])

ArchetypeProperty.Name: ResponseDeadline
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Seconds the client has to answer a challenge before it counts as a strike

ArchetypeProperty.Name: PositionTolerance
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Max meters the client-reported position may differ from the server's authoritative position

ArchetypeProperty.Name: HealthTolerance
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Max health difference tolerated between the client-reported and authoritative value

ArchetypeProperty.Name: MaxStrikes
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Failed/missed audits before the client is flagged (and kicked if Kick On Failure is set)

ArchetypeProperty.Name: KickOnFailure
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Disconnect the client once Max Strikes is reached (otherwise only log)

ArchetypeProperty.Name: AttestEveryNChallenges
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Attach a randomized-program attestation to every Nth audit challenge (0 disables attestation)

ArchetypeProperty.Name: AttestOpCount
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Operations per attestation program (more ops = harder to emulate quickly, slightly more CPU)

ArchetypeProperty.Name: PowRequired
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Require a memory-hard proof-of-work from each client after spawn (makes throwaway accounts / reconnect loops costly)

ArchetypeProperty.Name: PowMemoryKib
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Memory-hard buffer size for the proof-of-work, in KiB

ArchetypeProperty.Name: PowPasses
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Random-walk passes over the proof-of-work buffer

ArchetypeProperty.Name: PowDifficultyBits
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Required leading zero bits: expected work doubles per bit (10 bits ~ 1024 evaluations)

ArchetypeProperty.Name: PowDeadline
ArchetypeProperty.Description: Seconds the client has to submit a valid proof-of-work before it counts as a strike

RemoteProcedure.Name: SetAuditKey
RemoteProcedure.Description: Delivers the per-session audit HMAC key (transport-protected by DTLS)

RemoteProcedure.Name: SendAuditChallenge
RemoteProcedure.Description: Unpredictable audit challenge: random nonce (+ optional attestation program seed) the client must answer inside an authenticated snapshot

RemoteProcedure.Name: SendAuditResponse
RemoteProcedure.Description: HMAC-authenticated client state snapshot (+ attestation digest) answering an audit challenge

RemoteProcedure.Name: SetPowChallenge
RemoteProcedure.Description: Memory-hard proof-of-work the client must solve after spawn (anti throwaway-account / reconnect-loop)
